note: What a check has actually cost and taken, so a probe can be priced before it is approved. Neutral job tags only; no file path, no client name. 'picked' runs were given a page list (the shape a probe uses) and are what the estimate is fitted to; whole-set runs are kept for the upper bound. A real probe appends its own row through eval.probe.cost.append_point, so the estimate corrects itself after the first one.

fields.pages: vendor pages the check was given
fields.cost_usd: what the run itself reported spending
fields.picked: true when the run was given a page list rather than the whole set
fields.note: anything that makes the row unusual

points.note: flag mode: the topic helpers and the whole-page look ran at scale, which no other row has
